doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

chapter: Early career: New Orleans to Tulsa
title: Leaving New Orleans with Nat Towles for Tulsa
summary: Pasley left in 1924 with Towles, who recruited New Orleans players for a Tulsa band; sidemen are named and they played Oklahoma for about a year.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters
